body:
EQ's provisional 🟰 finalized as ⚓ (founder-confirmed). New LET (✨): Let ::= LET Value Expr, lowering directly to real PARENA (let [x v] body) rather than the source spec's own De Bruijn/environment-matrix scheme -- real architectural simplification since PARENA already has let. Found and fixed a real parser bug (bare MAGNET didn't check for a following arith op). Verified end-to-end: a real Let program compiled through parena build + cc + execution, correct exit code. 15 tests, go build/vet/test clean. LO commit 134449c.

⚓ ☃
title: Real EQ glyph (⚓) finalized + real LET (✨) support, verified end-to-end
